map.胎盘成熟度分级 0 至 III 级：0 级（不超过29 周）绒毛板光滑、I 级（: Placental maturity grade 0 to III: 0 (<=29 wks) smooth chorionic plate, I (28-32 wks) slight waviness, II (32-36 wks) indentations into parenchyma, III (>=37 wks) indentations to basal plate with calcification.
map.切迹深入未达基底: Indentations deep but not to basal plate
map.绒毛板光滑呈平直线状，胎盘实质为均匀细密的低回声点状回声，基底板无回声增强。见于: Smooth straight chorionic plate, uniform fine low-echo speckles in parenchyma, no basal-plate enhancement. Seen in early-mid pregnancy.
map.绒毛板出现轻微波浪状起伏，胎盘实质内可见散在强回声点，基底板仍无回声改变。多见于: Slight waviness of chorionic plate, scattered bright spots in parenchyma, basal plate still unchanged. Common at 28-32 wks.
map.绒毛板出现切迹并深入胎盘实质但未达基底板，实质内可见逗点状强回声，基底板出现线状: Chorionic plate indentations into parenchyma but not to basal plate, comma bright echoes in parenchyma, linear basal-plate echoes. Seen after 32 wks.
map.绒毛板切迹深达基底板，胎盘实质内可见环状钙化伴声影，基底板呈融合的强回声钙化斑。: Chorionic indentations deep to basal plate, ring calcification with acoustic shadow, confluent bright basal calcification. Seen after 37 wks (term).
map.提示：胎盘分级是胎盘成熟度的形态学描述，不完全等同于胎盘功能。III级胎盘在足月: Tip: placental grading is a morphological description of maturity, not identical to function. Grade III is normal after term, but if it appears too early (e.g. <36 wks) it may signal premature aging; combine with fetal movement, NST, AFI, etc.
map.超声按胎盘钙化与基底板分级（0–III）。: Ultrasound grades by calcification and basal plate (0-III).
map.识别胎盘过早老化（早产周出现 III 级）。: Identify premature aging (grade III before term weeks).
map.结合胎龄评估胎盘功能。: Assess placental function with fetal age.
map.孕 30 周超声见 III 级胎盘（基底板融合、钙化明显）：早于 36 周出现: At 30 wks ultrasound shows grade III (fused basal plate, marked calcification): III before 36 wks suggests premature aging; intensify fetal-heart and amniotic-fluid monitoring.
map.孕 34 周为 II 级、孕 38 周后为 III 级属正常成熟进程，反映胎盘老: Grade II at 34 wks and III after 38 wks is a normal maturation process, matching placental aging to fetal age.
map.足月后 III 级正常；但若 <36 周出现提示过早老化，可能伴胎儿生长受限，需: After term, III is normal; but if it appears <36 wks it may accompany FGR and needs comprehensive assessment, not grading alone.
map.分级仅反映形态成熟度，与功能并非完全对应；功能更靠脐血流、胎心监护与生物物理评分: Grading only reflects morphological maturity, not fully function; function relies more on umbilical flow, CTG and biophysical score.
map.胎盘成熟度(Grannum分级)器，根据B超胎盘钙化、绒毛板等影像特征按Gran: The Grannum grading tool assesses placental maturity from ultrasound calcification, chorionic plate and other imaging features. A professional medical tool based on authoritative standards, for reference only.
